# PNEUMA — Gospel of Mary, Chapter 8
**Agent:** PNEUMA (Dynamic/Functional)
**Source:** P.Berol. 8502, Gospel of Mary, p. 11-14 | Coptic
**Chapter:** 8

---

[Pages 11-14 of the manuscript are lost. Chapter 8 falls entirely within this second lacuna. No Greek fragment covers this portion. The account of Mary's vision — specifically the soul's confrontation with the lower cosmic powers — resumes in chapter 10.]
